title: Eleven Rows and One Gate
subtitle: 人群与聚集 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人群与聚集（社会服务与人际沟通·公共场所）
meta: 主题语境：人群与聚集（社会服务与人际沟通·公共场所）　|　核心词汇：crowd　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 crowd 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my father ① joined a crowd at a gate that opened eleven minutes late, and he said the joining was the whole of the waiting. The ② crowd, meaning the people and not the noise, filled eleven rows and stayed that deep; crowd, he said, is the only thing at a gate that is judged by how patiently it stands.

Every ③ crowd in that town had the same policeman on a horse, and the ④ crowd at the end, meaning the one he kept for the bonfire and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described twice. Crowd, my mother said, is nine parts policeman and one part somebody willing to stand; my father said the standing is the part that fills eleven rows.

My grandmother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the crowd was the whole of the room, meaning the set of people she knew and not the gathering. The ⑥ crowd, meaning the set of people and not any of that, is the only thing in a room that everybody belongs to and nobody invites; crowd, she said, is either something you join or the only word that means both a gathering and a set of people. He said the set of people is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ crowd had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the policeman. The ⑧ crowd of the whole thing, my father wrote in November, was one gate and thirty years of standing; crowd, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand. She said the standing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ crowd I remember is the one at the end, which he joined in 1968 and is still described as the deepest in the county. A ⑩ crowd, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being described; every crowd, she said, is a set of people that has agreed to look like a gathering. She said the set of people was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 人群（指那些人本身，与那些嘈杂声相对）
C. 固定搭配：join a crowd 加入人群
D. n. 人群（指那个镇上每一次聚集）
E. n. 人群（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 一伙人；圈子（指常在一起的那群人）
G. n. 人群（指报告里提到的那一次）
H. n. 群众；聚集（抽象总称）

items.q: joined a crowd at a gate that opened eleven minutes late
The crowd, meaning the people and not the noise
the crowd was the whole of the room
The crowd, meaning the set of people
the crowd had become a line in a report
The crowd of the whole thing
A crowd, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: join a crowd 意为“加入人群”，1954 年父亲在一扇晚了十一分钟才开的门口加入了人群。
crowd 意为“人群”，指那些人本身而不是那些嘈杂声，排了十一排那么深。
crowd 指那个镇上每一次人群聚集，每一次都有同一个骑警在场。
crowd 指末尾那一次（他留给篝火之夜的那一次），是唯一有人描述过两次的。
crowd 意为“一伙人、圈子”，祖母说那一伙人就是那个房间的全部，指的是常在一起的那群人而不是那次聚集。
crowd 为口语用法，指常在一起的那群人而不是那次聚集，是房间里人人都归属其中、却无人邀请的东西。
crowd 意为“人群”，指报告里提到的那一次，到 1962 年这次人群聚集成了报告里的一行。
crowd 意为“群众、聚集”，父亲十一月写道，整件事的聚集是一扇门三十年的站立。
crowd 意为“人群”，我记得的是末尾那一次，他 1968 年加入，至今仍被说成全县最深的。
crowd 为抽象总称，母亲说一次人群聚集是唯一会因为被描述而变好的东西。
